description: The room window shows only the interface bundled in the app (local pages). It may report call state (and the microphone level) to the tray and the call controls card, use the native model engine (docs/ENGINES.md) and run the voice call the app runs itself (host.voice, macOS; docs/BRIDGE.md), reach this computer's own core through the app (the local host: its state, its pairing, the service's actions, and installing Sidevoice on this computer from the npm registry, docs/LOCAL_HOST.md), and (CI and diagnostics only, printed with SIDEVOICE_DEBUG=1) print a debug line. It may read and set the global mute shortcut and whether the call controls card always shows during a call (host.muteShortcut, host.callControls; docs/BRIDGE.md). In a release, it may read and set how the app's updates arrive, read their status, check, download and restart into a downloaded update (host.updater; docs/BRIDGE.md). Nothing else.
